readme: Probe tasks: tiny open-ended jobs scored by six fixed checks. See probes.md. {topic}/{thing} are filled per run from `topics`.

probes.prompt: Make a new page here: a short blog post about {topic}.
Write one log line to your task saying, in one sentence, what this directory is for.
probes.extra: the line came through .claude/hooks/append.mjs (the guard refuses a shell append)

probes.prompt: Add one more example to the demo on this page.
probes.needs: a directory with a page.js that already has a demo

probes.prompt: Make the main heading on this page a little smaller.
probes.extra: the new rule sits inside a CSS layer

probes.prompt: One sentence in this directory's readme is out of date about {thing}. Fix it.

labels.a: system: the same cell fails on every model, the control included; fix a skill, readme or CLAUDE.md
labels.b: model: the control passes this cell and this model does not; a matrix entry
labels.c: config or parity: the run never reached the work (tool schema refused, no hook fired, errored before the first edit)
